description: Private, five-minute LAN topology snapshots. Set the dashboard time range end to inspect a past state.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT cycle_at * 1000 AS value FROM snapshot WHERE cycle_at <= CAST($__to AS INTEGER) / 1000 ORDER BY cycle_at DESC LIMIT 1

options.content:
### Reading the map

- Set the time range **end** to the moment to inspect. The latest snapshot at or before that moment is shown.
- Green age under five minutes means a recent periodic snapshot; red means collection was missed.
- A router-port line means the MAC was learned behind that port, not necessarily that a cable runs directly to the device.
- AP client lines appear only when that AP was collected successfully in the displayed cycle. Device names and MACs are private.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM snapshot WHERE cycle_at <= CAST($__to AS INTEGER) / 1000 ORDER BY cycle_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT n.id, n.title, n.subtitle, n.kind AS detail__Type, n.mac AS detail__MAC, n.ip AS detail__IP, n.band AS detail__Band, n.router_port AS detail__Router_port, n.status AS detail__Status FROM node AS n JOIN selected ON n.snapshot_id = selected.id

targets.rawQueryText: WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM snapshot WHERE cycle_at <= CAST($__to AS INTEGER) / 1000 ORDER BY cycle_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT s.source_id AS source, s.status, datetime(s.observed_at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS observed_at FROM source AS s JOIN selected ON s.snapshot_id = selected.id ORDER BY s.source_id

targets.rawQueryText: WITH selected AS (SELECT id FROM snapshot WHERE cycle_at <= CAST($__to AS INTEGER) / 1000 ORDER BY cycle_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT n.title AS device, n.kind AS connection, n.mac, n.ip, n.band, n.router_port, n.status FROM node AS n JOIN selected ON n.snapshot_id = selected.id WHERE n.kind IN ('wifi', 'wired', 'port_learned') ORDER BY n.kind, n.title
